newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil senate approves re-election bill.
newsitem.headline: Brazil senate approves re-election bill.

text.p: The Brazilian Senate Wednesday approved by a wide margin a bill that would allow President Fernando Henrique Cardoso to stand for re-election, an official said.
Senate President Antonio Carlos Magalhaes said 63 senators voted for, six against and nine abstained. The bill must pass through a second vote in the Senate later.
"The margin was way above expectations," said political analyst Ricardo Pedreira of Santafe Ideias, who was watching the debate.
Senators were still voting on a series of proposed amendments to the bill.

President Cardoso has made the re-election bill one of the central planks of his administration. But, the law has recently become embroiled in controversy because of allegations that deputies in the lower house were paid by state governors to vote in favor of it.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
